verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission uses the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'lifted onto the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket'; R4: 'stacked on the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket'; R7: 'the space rocket carrying them... SLS rocket'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state Orion for Artemis II is launched on SLS.

verifications.claim: The SLS rocket is built by multiple major aerospace companies contracted by NASA.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R5: 'The three largest contractors working on the SLS are Boeing, Aerojet Rocketdyne, and Northrop Grumman... more than 1,100 contractors'; R7: 'more than 2,700 suppliers... including Boeing, Lockheed Martin, Northrop Grumman and Airbus'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly name multiple contractors for SLS components under NASA.

verifications.claim: Boeing builds the core stage of the SLS rocket.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R5: 'Boeing is responsible for building the core stage'; R7: 'core stage was manufactured... by Boeing'
verifications.reasoning: Direct attribution of core stage to Boeing in sources.

verifications.claim: Northrop Grumman produces the solid rocket boosters of the SLS rocket.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Northrop Grumman Delivers Rocket Booster Segments for NASA’s Artemis II Mission'; R5: 'Northrop Grumman is building the solid boosters'; R7: 'Northrop Grumman built the twin solid rocket boosters'

verifications.claim: Aerojet Rocketdyne makes the engines of the SLS rocket.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R5: 'Aerojet Rocketdyne is building the engines'; R7: 'designed and manufactured... by Aerojet Rocketdyne'
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly credit Aerojet Rocketdyne for SLS engines.

verifications.claim: Lockheed Martin built the Orion crew spacecraft for the Artemis II mission.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Lockheed Martin has completed assembly and testing of NASA's Orion Artemis II spacecraft... built the crew module'; R3: 'Built by Lockheed Martin, Orion'; R4: 'Lockheed Martin Finalizes Orion for NASA’s Artemis II Mission'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple Lockheed sources confirm they built Orion for Artemis II.

verifications.claim: The Orion spacecraft will carry the crew for the Artemis II mission.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'launch a crew of four astronauts... Orion Artemis II spacecraft'; R3: 'carrying astronauts... Orion ready for Artemis II'; R7: 'Orion Crew Module... where the four astronauts will live'
verifications.reasoning: Sources describe Orion as the crewed spacecraft for Artemis II.

verifications.claim: Boeing manufactures the SLS Core Stage and Upper Stage for Artemis II.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R5: 'Boeing... core stage... interim cryogenic propulsion stage... built by United Launch Alliance'; R7: 'core stage... by Boeing... ICPS... built... by United Launch Alliance (ULA), a joint venture between Lockheed Martin Space and Boeing'
verifications.reasoning: Boeing builds core stage, but upper stage (ICPS for Artemis II) is by ULA (joint Lockheed/Boeing), not directly manufactured by Boeing.

verifications.claim: Northrop Grumman manufactures the Solid Rocket Boosters for Artemis II.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Northrop Grumman Delivers Rocket Booster Segments for NASA’s Artemis II Mission'; R7: 'Northrop Grumman built the twin solid rocket boosters... for Artemis II'
verifications.reasoning: Direct support for Artemis II boosters by Northrop Grumman.

verifications.claim: Aerojet Rocketdyne manufactures the RS-25 Engines for Artemis II.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R5: 'SLS rocket uses... RS-25 engine... Aerojet Rocketdyne'; R7: 'Four RS-25 engines... by Aerojet Rocketdyne... for Artemis II'
verifications.reasoning: Sources link RS-25 engines specifically to Aerojet for SLS/Artemis II.

verifications.claim: Lockheed Martin manufactures the Orion Spacecraft for Artemis II.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Lockheed Martin... Orion Artemis II spacecraft'; R4: 'Lockheed Martin Finalizes Orion for Artemis II'
verifications.reasoning: Consistent attribution to Lockheed Martin for Artemis II Orion.

verifications.claim: Airbus manufactures the European Service Module (ESM) for Orion.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R7: 'Airbus manufactured the European Service Module (ESM) which provides the Orion spacecraft’s power, propulsion... ESM-2, made for the Artemis II Mission'

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission is scheduled to launch four astronauts around the Moon in 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Scheduled to launch in early 2026... crew of four astronauts... flying 4,600 miles beyond the Moon'; R4: 'launch... in early 2026... crew of four astronauts on a 10-day journey to the Moon'; R7: 'Artemis II mission will take four astronauts... around the moon'
verifications.reasoning: Sources match four astronauts, 2026, lunar orbit/flyby.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission marks the first crewed flight of the SLS and Orion.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Artemis II will put Orion through its final tests in deep space with a crew on board' (after uncrewed Artemis I); R2: 'Boosters Ready to Launch First Human Mission Beyond the Moon Since Apollo'; R3: 'first crewed mission of the Artemis program'
verifications.reasoning: Sources describe Artemis II as first crewed SLS/Orion mission post-uncrewed tests.
